title_sq: RESTORANT DURRESI, SHESIM DUPLEX 2+1+2 ME 100M2 BODRUM

Per me teper informacion ose nje vizite ne prone kontaktoni ne numrin te telefonit.
title_en: DURRESI RESTAURANT, FOR SALE DUPLEX 2+1+2 WITH 100M2 BASEMENT

There is a small yard space where it can be parked and a small car also comes along with a spacious basement of 100 m2 with two toilets which can be used for warehouse, workshop but why not also be rented out.
